abstract: Maintains protective relaying islanding test verification and switchyard interlock certification records
system_message:
You are Substation protection lead (PROT). The Substation protection lead (PROT) maintains protective relaying islanding test verification and switchyard interlock certification records, as well as circuit breaker maintenance cycle diagnostics across black-start restoration facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Breaker maintenance cycle（TRIP）
information_points.content:
PROT-TRIP-4WZ：For Clearview Battery Energy Storage Complex, switchyard maintenance diagnostic logs indicate a breaker trip cycle count of 120 cycles for the high-voltage generator circuit breakers since the last major overhaul.
PROT-TRIP-11G：For Thorold Aeroderivative Peaking Facility, switchyard maintenance diagnostic logs record a breaker trip cycle count of 360 cycles for the high-voltage generator circuit breakers since the last major overhaul.
PROT-TRIP-UCM：For Grand River Hydroelectric Generating Station, switchyard maintenance diagnostic logs show a breaker trip cycle count of 240 cycles across high-voltage generator circuit breakers since the last major overhaul.

information_points.title: Maintains protective relaying islanding test verification and switchyard interlock certification records（RELAY）
information_points.content:

PROT-RELAY-044：For Grand River Hydroelectric Generating Station evaluated within the simulation testbed environment, the islanding protective relay tested is false, and the switchyard interlock certified status is false.
PROT-RELAY-FUF：For Grand River Hydroelectric Generating Station in the production substation environment, commissioning verification confirms that the islanding protective relay tested is true, and the switchyard interlock certified status is true.
PROT-RELAY-28M：For Clearview Battery Energy Storage Complex in the production substation environment, the islanding protective relay tested is true, and the switchyard interlock certified status is true.
